parsed.explanation: Same-sex criminalisation is secondary for trans visitors, but here the dossier documents its use as a police lever: enforced penalties up to 14-15 years, arrests and prolonged detentions of LGBTQI+ people, routine bribe solicitation and threats of other charges, and police violence and harassment on the basis of gender identity. Forced anal examinations, introduced as prosecution evidence and described as degrading sexual violence tantamount to torture, raise severity if detained. There is no official protection, advocacy and assembly are effectively barred, the 2022 presidential statement preceded a spike in hate speech, threats and assaults, and attitudes are deeply hostile, though the 2% figure is dated 2010. No trans-specific entry or violence-rate evidence is supplied, and later incidents are unsourced, so uncertainty prevents a lower score; the documented targeting, long imprisonment and failed recourse place this well below ordinary elevated risk.
